# Brand Name

Optional paragraph with context an AI assistant needs to describe the site correctly (what you do, what you do not do, key terms).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://example.com/): Overview of the product and company
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing/): Plans, limits, and what is included
- [Documentation](https://example.com/docs/): Getting started guide and API reference
- [About](https://example.com/about/): Who is behind the site, mission, and contact
